**Grant Application: Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) - Culturally Relevant Gun Safety Education**

Gun violence disproportionately impacts Sacramento's communities of color. Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC), a minority-owned social enterprise, directly addresses this by fostering essential gun safety education. Partnering with Church of Legacy, we build trust, delivering impactful prevention strategies from within these communities.

Programs include "Gloxsie 21," a cartoon IP engaging youth with age-appropriate gun safety lessons. We empower adults through "AI Education" workshops for safety advocacy. Community Workshops offer practical training: responsible firearm storage, handling, and conflict de-escalation.

Everytown support will significantly enhance gun safety literacy, measurably reducing accidental firearm injuries and promoting responsible ownership. We will cultivate proactive community dialogue, destigmatize safety discussions, and empower residents with vital knowledge.

Deeply rooted and minority-owned, GAFC possesses unique cultural competency and trust. Our blend of innovative IP, AI education, and direct engagement reaches underserved demographics, building resilience and agency from within.

We respectfully request $50,000-$200,000 from the Everytown Safety Fund to expand our critical work, creating safer, more informed Sacramento.
